column2: This workbook evaluates the risk–return profile of a two-asset portfolio using historical weekly return data. Under sheet "WEEKLY_RETURNS", return distributions are analysed to estimate volatility, correlation, and Value at Risk (VaR). Under sheet "Risk_and_Portfolio_Metrics", portfolio optimisation techniques are then applied to construct the efficient frontier, identify minimum-variance and maximum risk-adjusted portfolios, and assess diversification effects. The impact of introducing a risk-free asset is examined, and sensitivity analysis is performed to evaluate changes in portfolio performance under varying assumptions. Key results are summarised on this sheet, with supporting calculations provided in subsequent worksheets.
